question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Miraculous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Incredible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Miraculous"** means something that is extraordinary and brings wonderful results, often in a way that cannot be explained by natural or scientific laws. (चमत्कारी)

 
 
• **Example: **The doctors said it was miraculous that she survived the accident without any injuries.
 
 
 
• **"Incredible"** refers to something so extraordinary or amazing that it is hard to believe. (अविश्वसनीय)
 
 
• **Example: **The view from the top of the mountain was incredible, beyond words to describe.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate synonym for **'Miraculous'** is **'Incredible'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Incredible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Draining** (थकाऊ): Causing someone to lose energy or become very tired.

 
 
• **Example:** The long hours of work can be very draining.
 
 
 
• **Average** (औसत): Typical or normal; not exceptional.
 
 
• **Example: **His performance in the test was average, not outstanding but not poor either.
 
 
 
• **Expected** (अपेक्षित): Regarded as likely to happen; anticipated.
 
 
• **Example:** The results were expected, given the amount of preparation he had done.
